# Halcyon Threshold — Strategy & Status
_Last updated: 2026-11-16_

## Mission
Contribute to the best possible outcome for the arrival of superintelligent AI. Deliberately open-ended — not committed to a single lane (research / writing / funding others / community) yet.

## Operator & constraints (from Morgan's own notes, doc_201)
- One person, evenings and weekends.
